say:2:1410451001:0.text: Xera, halt! Come here and rectify this at once!
say:2:1410451001:0.source_cn: 席蕾，你站住！快来给我解决事情！

say:3:1410451002:1.source_cn: 哦……女王在上，怎么又是他……

say:4:1410451003:1.text: *Ahem* Lord Valvaris, how may I assist you?
say:4:1410451003:1.source_cn: 咳——拉瑟隆大人，有何吩咐？

say:5:1410451004:1.text: A lowborn dared to flee during my midday rest! This is a blatant insult! An affront to my honor!
say:5:1410451004:1.source_cn: 一个仆从竟然趁我午憩之时逃跑！这是活生生的挑衅！是践踏...

say:6:1410451005:0.text: You will find her and bring her back immediately! I shall cleanse this disgrace with her blood!
say:6:1410451005:0.source_cn: 你们得把她抓回来，立刻！马上！我要用她的鲜血洗刷耻辱！

say:8:1410451007:0.text: I shall adorn my gates with a fitting new trophy... perhaps the head of a commoner guard!
say:8:1410451007:0.source_cn: 我会用新的装饰品……比如，这个平民卫兵的脑袋来点缀我家大门！

say:10:1410451008:1.text: It's him again. This is hardly the first time.
say:10:1410451008:1.source_cn: 拉瑟隆又来了，这事可不是一次两次了。
say:10:1410451008:1.male: It's him again. This is hardly the first time.
say:10:1410451008:1.female: It's him again. This is hardly the first time.

say:12:1410451009:0.text: We've helped him complete tasks, but... those who were returned... well, I trust you can imagine their unfortunate end.
say:12:1410451009:0.source_cn: 我们完成了任务，但被抓回来的人……你一定能想象他们的下场。
say:12:1410451009:0.male: We've helped him complete tasks, but... those who were returned... well, I trust you can imagine their unfortunate end.
say:12:1410451009:0.female: We've helped him complete tasks, but... those who were returned... well, I trust you can imagine their unfortunate end.

say:13:1410451011:1.text: I suspect I know where she's hiding. This will be a simple task. Let's proceed.
say:13:1410451011:1.source_cn: 我大概知道她躲在哪里。这是个简单的练手任务，走吧。

say:15:1410451010:0.source_cn: 是啊，他们命运不济，摊上这样的主人。
